title.zh: 【三井住友信托银行将收购 Bitbank 所持 JADAT 全部股份，预计 10 月 1 日完成】
title.en: 【三井住友信托银行将收购 Bitbank 所持 JADAT 全部股份，预计 10 月 1 日完成】

current_state.zh: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank will acquire all JADAT shares held by crypto exchange Bitbank, making the digital-asset trust preparation company a wholly owned subsidiary by around October 1, ahead of filing for trust business registration.
current_state.en: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank will acquire all JADAT shares held by crypto exchange Bitbank, making the digital-asset trust preparation company a wholly owned subsidiary by around October 1, ahead of filing for trust business registration.
